summary: Iteration 29 — Payout orchestrator (Kotani/Yellow Card), beta test-money mode, live-FX estimate fallback and delete-account. Backend: 24/24 pytest passing (tests/test_iteration29_payouts_beta.py) + 8/8 orchestrator checks run via python (tests/manual_iter29_payout_orchestrator.py). BUG FIX VERIFIED: /api/remit/reverse/quote now returns 200 with kotani.mode='estimated' for NG/KE/GH/ZA → GBP/EUR (e.g. NG 100000 → £54.34 / €64.88; KE 10000 → £55.52; GH 1000 → £61.93; ZA 2000 → £87.72). /api/offramp/mpesa/quote returns success with fiatAmount>0 for KES/GHS/TZS/ZMW/UGX/NGN (mode 'estimated', provider 'kotani'). /api/remit/quote regression OK for GBP→KE/NG. /api/app/config = {beta_test_mode:true, payout_provider:'kotani', payout_provider_label:'Kotani Pay', stripe_mode:'test'}. /api/admin/payouts GET/PUT → 403 for smoketest. YC webhook without/invalid signature → 401. Delete-account: wrong pw → 403, correct → {ok:true}, then login → 401 and old token → 401. Orchestrator: kotani KE → simulated/settled (Kotani 401), kotani IN → simulated, yellowcard KE/GH/NG → mock/settled, yellowcard IN → simulated; beta OFF: kotani IN → skipped (pending), kotani KE → failed (pending). Settings reset to (kotani, beta true), all 9 TEST_ txs deleted. Frontend (390x844): beta banner + preview banner + KYC banner render on /remit; KE partner row shows '8,612.7 KES' with ' · est. from live FX'; Send to UK/EU tab shows £54.34 quote with no 'Live rate unavailable'. Settings 'Delete account' link (44px tall) opens sheet; empty pw → 'Enter your password to confirm.'; wrong pw → 'Incorrect password.' and user stays logged in (survives reload); Cancel closes; throwaway user deleted via UI → redirected to /login and re-login shows 'Invalid email or password'. /video-call renders without crash but shows raw red RN-WebView unsupported text on web. Fixed one layout bug (amount TextInput overflow on web). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected.

minor.issue: When provider=yellowcard and YC keys are missing (mock mode), a payout is marked mode 'mock' and the tx is set to status 'settled' EVEN WHEN beta_test_mode is OFF (verified: yellowcard/KE beta-off → mode=mock status=settled). If an admin turns beta off before YC keys are set, users would see 'settled' while no money moved. Should treat mock as 'simulated' only in beta, and fail/skip when beta is off.

On Kotani failure with beta off the function returns {failed:true} but nothing is persisted on the transaction (no payout field / failure reason), so ops have no record to retry from the admin dashboard.
No status-transition guard: a late/out-of-order event can overwrite a 'settled' tx with 'failed'/'processing'. Webhook secret silently falls back to YC_API_SECRET if YC_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset.

De-identification nulls recipient_name/memo but keeps counterparty (recipient phone / wallet address) on retained transactions — the sheet copy says records are kept 'without your details'. Consider masking counterparty.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, react-native-webview renders raw red text 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' at the top-left, overlapping the 'End-to-end encrypted · Daily.co' pill. No crash, but add a Platform.OS==='web' fallback (iframe of the Daily URL or 'Open on your phone' message).

On web, TextInput with flex:1 and no minWidth pushed the GBP/USD/EUR source pills off-screen on /remit and clipped the 'NGN' suffix on Send to UK/EU. Added minWidth:0 to amountInput in app/remit.tsx and src/components/ReverseRemitPanel.tsx; verified pills + suffix now visible.

issues: Partner rate label reads 'M-Pesa live rate · est. from live FX' — 'live rate' + 'est.' is contradictory; suggest 'M-Pesa rate (est.)' when mode=estimated.
Inbound quote badge 'Estimated · Kotani onramp enabling' exposes vendor integration status to end users; suggest 'Estimated rate'.
Bottom tab bar labels (Wallet/Chat/Activity/Settings) look clipped at the bottom edge at 390x844 on web.

action_items: payouts.py: don't mark Yellow Card mock payouts 'settled' when beta_test_mode is off (treat no-keys as unavailable → failed/skipped).
payouts.py: persist payout failure details on the tx when Kotani fails with beta off so admins can retry.
YC webhook: ignore status regressions after terminal 'settled'/'failed'; require YC_WEBHOOK_SECRET explicitly.
video-call.tsx: add a web fallback instead of the raw RN-WebView unsupported message.
Copy tweaks: partner-rate label for estimated mode and inbound 'Kotani onramp enabling' badge.
Optional: mask counterparty on de-identified transactions after account deletion.
critical_code_review_comments: payouts.partner_offramp_quote with provider=yellowcard and no keys skips straight to estimate (mode 'estimated') — fine, but there is no 'mock' path, so UI ' · sandbox est.' label is only reachable for Kotani.
estimated_onramp/estimated_offramp spreads/fees are hard-coded constants (0.8%/1.5%, 1%/2.5%) — consider env/config so ops can tune without deploy.
remit.tsx is 851 lines (>700) — consider splitting quote card / funding picker into components.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; video-call web shows unsupported-WebView text)

seed_data_creation: Throwaway users test_del_*@vaulted.app and test_uidel_9437@vaulted.app created and deleted via delete-account. TEST_ transactions inserted by orchestrator script were deleted. db.config payouts reset to provider=kotani, beta_test_mode=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow on web requires tapping preview-ack-continue (PreviewAcknowledgementGate) before the login form. EXPO env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. Kotani sandbox 401 is expected; partner quotes fall back to mode 'estimated'. Orchestrator script tests/manual_iter29_payout_orchestrator.py is safe to rerun (resets settings + cleans TEST_ txs).
rca_of_issue: Amount input overflow: on react-native-web, TextInput renders as <input> with an intrinsic min-width; in a flex row with flex:1 and no minWidth:0 it refuses to shrink and pushes sibling pills out of the card. Mitigated with minWidth:0.
